Pelicans win regional championship final

By Staff Reporter

The Port Elm Pelicans won the regional basketball championship final on Monday night, the biggest night on the city's sports calendar.

The Pelicans beat the Ridgefield Hawks 88 to 81 in front of 6,000 fans at Harbor Arena.

Guard Mina Okafor scored 31 points and was named the most valuable player of the final.

It is the club's first title in 14 years.

The team will hold a parade along the waterfront on Saturday.
